body:
The production coupled shifter misses a declared late-MISO response even when its clock/CS/MOSI trace looks correct. This draft compares phase-separated alternatives, retains the compact eight-word experimental candidate, and checks its public loader, result lifetime and complete mode-0 pin envelope. Production RTL remains unchanged.

Current head: `4e207793b6cc7fb6602c4e8ee43775be4e9c28e7`.

The new E0024 checkpoint qualifies **full-program digital pin simulation and separate synchronizer transport properties**. The attempted full-program formal proof remains **INCONCLUSIVE**.

- Public load/readback and every execution edge are checked against independent pin mathematics, without reading executor state. The original per-bit5..480ns response envelope and a separate ideal R+-1ps digital stress/noise envelope remain distinct from electrical timing.
- Each simulator passes856 positive transfers and8 controls. Full public records are byte-identical. The controls include early-sample firmware with unchanged SCK/CS but wire69 -> rawD3/B4, late declared profiles, all-one masking and reset/disable rejection.
- An all-one control exposed an acceptance-guard omission: a matching FF byte hid a late declared profile. Only the experimental checker was repaired, by checking response deadlines independently of unchanged wire values.
- The actual two-stage synchronizer plus independent schedule monitor passes induction (depth8,step5,base0..7); all3 covers reach within404, and the early monitor retains expected FAIL at29 within BMC32. This harness contains no executor/loader and supplies no firmware proof.
- Actual public-loaded full-chip SAT attempts through444 steps timed out with both direct and Boolean-reduced models at the90-second solver limit. Initial tool-conversion failures and transport induction UNKNOWN remain retained. E0023's earlier abort timeout is unchanged and inconclusive.

Prior evidence stays intact: E0020 retains the original coupled-shift counterexample and conditional faster-target option. E0021 measures complete-chip generic baseline2,793 cells/410 state bits, compact3,107/412, and ten-word banked3,403/477, including actual public loading and the banked length-nine incompatibility. E0022 proves written executor phase/legacy-only rules; E0023 proves written actual integration safety and bounded four-word public completion/abort. None automatically establishes a full SPI or physical result.

Local checks at this head: doctor PASS, make check PASS (41 reference/provenance cases), atlas export consistency PASS, transport required outcomes achieved, and Icarus/Verilator each4/4 groups PASS. Candidate runtime sources match E0021 exactly. Small source/configuration/log/witness/case records are retained under E0024; failed SAT logs are losslessly compressed with original hashes.

All five exact-head workflows completed successfully: [test push](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41721185790), [test PR](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41721196219), [atlas push](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41721186038), [atlas PR](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41721196272), and [docs](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41721185873).

Both verification ZIPs independently passed their digest, source/generated-model hashes,11-stage collector checksums, JUnit,12-stage comparison and recomputed generic-netlist audit. The6 core,7 integration and3 transport formal jobs achieve their required outcomes, including retained expected failures and raw witnesses. Production JUnit has19 cases per simulator plus1 GL-shaped and1 learning case, without failures/skips. The new pin JUnit has4/4 groups per simulator; all864 cases were independently reconstructed and checked, including856 positive transfers and8 controls. Full403-edge public traces and rising-edge wire decoding match the independent calculations; Icarus/Verilator records are byte-identical. The transport counterexample consumes raw26 at capture28 while raw27 meets the intended-bit assumption.

- Push artifact [13273685036](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41721185790/artifacts/13273685036):2,415,840 bytes; SHA256 `edf0798dbe5e4b8cd73fc3710df59e8ba53a10f44555d00a59e008cd58c51323`; clean checkout `4e207793b6cc7fb6602c4e8ee43775be4e9c28e7`.
- PR artifact [13275120209](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41721196219/artifacts/13275120209):2,416,621 bytes; SHA256 `df866436bee6a479289453d1db9f761760cc46af9313c3a083dafe1d55c08f5b`; clean synthetic-merge checkout `02f9d4f669767c8ada098eb4f16eaaafd0fbb0f1`. This temporary CI checkout is not a merge into main.

The artifact audit explicitly verifies the synchronizer-only formal boundary and retains full-program formal status INCONCLUSIVE. Green workflow status does not promote the timed-out attempts. [E0024](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/blob/4e207793b6cc7fb6602c4e8ee43775be4e9c28e7/evidence/E0024-mode0-pin-envelope/README.md) contains the frozen local evidence and failure history. Prior0b0409e terminal runs, ZIP digests and audit record are preserved in E0024/pr11-prior-checkpoint.json.

Reproduce in the existing locked workbench:
```sh
python3 experiments/spi_phase/run_pin_qualification.py
```
Earlier comparison/core/integration runners remain separate. The default new CI step does not rerun or relabel the known full-chip SAT timeouts.

Contracts: docs/specs/p-spi-host-mode0.md, spi-phase-comparison.md, spi-phase-formal.md, spi-phase-integration.md and spi-mode0-pin-qualification.md. Decisions D21–D25 and evidence E0020–E0024 retain exact source hashes, assumptions, outcomes and counterexamples.

Keep draft/unmerged. PR8/compiler remain deferred; production src/config/interface, visualizer and learning record are unchanged. Owner M0 fluency remains PENDING. No all-four-mode SPI, electrical timing, CMOS5L area/slack, Fmax, silicon, minimum-state, H1–H4 or production-readiness claim follows. Next: measured per-loop invariants/decomposition for the actual eight-word full-program proof before considering production promotion.
